job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Agentic AI Engineer to join our team at FlytBase Labs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with excellent problem-solving skills.
Roles and Responsibility
Design and develop agent-based models for complex systems.
Implement machine learning algorithms to enhance system performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.
Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines for AI model training.
Conduct thorough testing and debugging of AI-powered applications.
Stay updated with industry trends and advancements in AI and machine learning.
Job Requirements
Strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and statistics.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java.
Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Excellent understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


Disclaimer: This job description has been sourced from a public domain and may have been modified by Naukri.com to improve clarity for our users. We encourage job seekers to verify all details directly with the employer via their official channels before applying.
